coach.title: Your coach is coming into focus
coach.body: Soon you can ask what to do next and rehearse interviews, with every answer grounded in your own verified evidence.
coach.note: Grounded only in evidence you choose to share. Never shared with employers.

no-applications.title: No applications yet
no-applications.body: When you apply for a role, you’ll follow every stage here, from applied and screening to interview and offer.
no-applications.helper: Your verified profile is ready. Employers see only the evidence you choose to send, never your readiness band.

no-interviews.title: No interviews scheduled
no-interviews.body: When an employer invites you, the round, time and a prep checklist will appear here and in your calendar.

no-assessments.title: No assessments assigned yet
no-assessments.body: Assessments from Lakeview or employers will show up here. Each one you complete becomes a verified evidence record.

learning-not-started.title: Your learning path is ready
learning-not-started.body: Start Career Readiness Fundamentals: three short lessons that build evidence for your goal.

no-scholarships.title: No scholarships match yet
no-scholarships.body: We’ll list scholarships that fit your programme and goal as institutions publish them.

no-documents.title: No documents yet
no-documents.body: Keep certificates and transcripts in one place. You decide what each employer can see.
no-documents.note: Documents stay private until you attach them to an application.

no-messages.title: No messages yet
no-messages.body: Messages from Lakeview staff and employers you’ve applied to will appear here.

search-no-results.title: No results for that search
search-no-results.body: Try a broader role title, fewer filters or a nearby city.

resume-empty.title: Start your resume from your evidence
resume-empty.body: We’ll pre-fill sections from your verified records. You review every line before anything is shared.

practice-start.title: Warm up with a practice set
practice-start.body: Ten questions, no time pressure. Practice answers are visible only to you.

queue-clear.title: Verification queue clear
queue-clear.body: New evidence submitted by Lakeview students will appear here for review.

no-students-roster.title: Add your first students
no-students-roster.body: Import your roster as a CSV or invite students by email. They activate their own accounts.

no-interventions.title: No interventions open
no-interventions.body: When a student needs extra support, plan an intervention here and track each follow-up.

no-placement-drives.title: No placement drives scheduled
no-placement-drives.body: Schedule a drive to invite employers. Student profiles are shared only with each student’s consent.

no-reports.title: No reports yet
no-reports.body: Build a report on cohort bands, activation or placement. Any count under five shows as <5.

no-meetings.title: No meetings this week
no-meetings.body: Schedule department reviews or student check-ins. Agendas and notes stay attached.

tasks-all-done.title: All tasks done
tasks-all-done.body: New verification requests and reviews will appear here as they arrive.

no-applicants.title: No applicants yet
no-applicants.body: Graduate Software Engineer is live. Applicants appear here with the evidence they choose to share.

talent-pool-empty.title: Your talent pool is empty
talent-pool-empty.body: Save candidates from any role to revisit later. They stay here only while their consent is active.

no-offers.title: No offers sent yet
no-offers.body: When you extend an offer, track acceptance and joining dates here.

no-opportunities-posted.title: Post your first opportunity
no-opportunities-posted.body: Describe the role and the evidence you’d like to see. Corvane Labs roles reach students at partner institutions.

all-systems-healthy.title: All systems healthy
all-systems-healthy.body: API, assessments, AI services and email delivery are operating normally.

no-flagged-items.title: Nothing flagged
no-flagged-items.body: Reported content and accounts will appear here for a decision.

audit-log-empty.title: No audit events in this range
audit-log-empty.body: Try a wider date range or remove the actor filter.

no-leads.title: No leads in this territory yet
no-leads.body: Add an institution you met in the field or import a list to start your pipeline.

target-achieved.title: Target achieved
target-achieved.body: You’ve hit this quarter’s target. Commission is calculated at month end.

404-not-found.title: We can’t find that page
404-not-found.body: The link may be out of date or the page has moved. Your data is safe.

500-something-went-wrong.title: Something went wrong on our side
500-something-went-wrong.body: We couldn’t load this page. Your saved work is safe; please try again in a moment.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Check your connection. We’ll reconnect automatically when you’re back online.

no-access.title: You don’t have access to this page
no-access.body: This area isn’t part of your role. Ask your administrator if you need it.

maintenance.title: We’re making ONE better
maintenance.body: Scheduled maintenance is under way. Your data and progress are safe.

coming-soon.title: Coming soon
coming-soon.body: We’re building this next. We’ll let you know as soon as it’s ready.

session-expired.title: Your session has expired
session-expired.body: For your security we sign you out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.

onboarding-welcome.title: Welcome to ONE, Arjun
onboarding-welcome.body: One workspace from learning to landing the role. Set your goal and add your first evidence.

success-generic.title: Submitted for verification
success-generic.body: Your evidence record was sent to Lakeview. We’ll notify you when it’s reviewed.
